description: Find a VA-accredited attorney, claim agent, or VSO representative (from the VA Office of General Counsel roster). VA-accredited VSO representatives help for free. Only accredited attorneys and claim agents may charge a fee, and only for work done after VA has issued an initial decision on the claim. Use when a veteran wants an accredited representative, for example for an appeal, CAVC or higher-level review.
name: find_accredited_representative
title: Find a VA-accredited representative
